name: Town of North Salem
gaps: Bulk rules are set per use group; values recorded are for the single-family detached use group named in each district's Table of General Use Requirements (R-4 b, R-2 m, R-1 e, R-1/2 f, R-1/4 h, R-MF/4 r, R-MF/6 q, PD-CCRC s)
No maximum number of stories in the Bulk Table; max_stories null
R-MF/6 and R-MF/4 both show a 5-acre minimum (50-acre max) in the Bulk Table, while the county layer lists 10 acres for R-MF/6; density is set by the separate Table of Uses and Density (not read)
PD-CCRC building coverage is printed as '25' without a % sign; recorded as 25%
No minimum lot depth and no separate accessory height limit found; no stand-alone steep slope law (lot-area discount in § 250-16A and tree permit on 15%+ slopes only)
Bulk Table attachment dated 09-01-2015; nonresidential districts (NB, GB, PO, RO) not checked for one-family use

wetlands.summary: Ch. 107: controlled area = wetlands, watercourses and all land within 100 ft of them; regulated activities there need a wetland permit (full permit e.g. for buildings or point discharges within 50 ft, 2,000+ sf new impervious, or 5,000+ sf disturbance in the controlled area).

steep_slopes.summary: No stand-alone steep slope law. Ch. 189 requires a tree permit for any tree removal on steep slopes (15%+ over 5,000 sf); § 250-16A counts at most 50% (25% in R-1/2, R-1/4) of 25%+ slopes toward minimum lot area.

trees.summary: Ch. 189: Planning Board permit to remove any tree 36 in.+ dbh, trees on steep slopes (15%+), in historic districts/roads or cluster common land, or more than a set number of 6 in.+ trees per year by lot size.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 193: stormwater permit/SWPPP for land development disturbing 5,000 sf or more (or part of a larger plan).

adu.summary: § 250-68: accessory apartments by Board of Appeals special permit, owner-occupied, in a main dwelling with 1,500+ sf habitable space or in a garage/accessory building (lot 2.5x the district minimum); 300-750 sf and max 25% of the house.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory structures may not be in any required yard (§ 250-20), except unroofed terraces/patios under 1 ft high, decks projecting up to 6 ft into the rear yard, fences and underground tanks (10 ft from lot lines) (§ 250-22). Garages in front yards only by ZBA approval for topography (§ 250-21B).
general.pools: Accessory swimming pools are permitted accessory uses but may not be in any required yard (§ 250-20).
general.notes: Fences max 4 ft in front yards and 5 ft in side/rear yards (6 ft deer fence allowed). Cluster (average density) subdivisions may use smaller-lot use groups (§§ 250-17, 250-18C).

max_floor_area.note: Gross floor area of all buildings / lot area; GFA includes basements, attics with 6'3"+ headroom, roofed porches and garages

accessory.notes: Accessory structures are not permitted in any required yard (§ 250-20); at least 15 ft (or the accessory building's height) from the principal building (§ 250-27B)
